projectDescription: A PyQt5-based desktop web browser themed around Among Us, with navigation controls and quick-access buttons for Discord, Steam, and YouTube.
keyFeatures: Among Us-themed desktop browser built with PyQt5 and QtWebEngine
Navigation toolbar with back, forward, and reload buttons
Home button that returns to the Among Us fan page
One-click quick-links: Discord, YouTube music, Steam store, creator's YouTube channel
Dynamic window title reflecting the current page title
